follow-up time: Time between first and second pregnancy
outcome: Recurrent small for gestational age (SGA) birth
cohort: 24,520 women with their first-ever and second consecutive deliveries in Aberdeen, Scotland
finding: Inter-pregnancy weight change was associated with the risk of recurrent hypertensive disorders, SGA, and LGA birth, with different patterns of association depending on the direction of weight change.
mod_finding: Weight loss between pregnancies was associated with an increased risk of elective Cesarean-section.
